summary: On the rooftop in daylight, Agent Smith stands fixed, "his face twisted with hate," convinced that "He will never escape the Matrix." He begins "He pivots away from the ledge," but then "he suddenly hears it," and reacts sharply, "his head whipping back around, staring--" The scene cuts off mid-action on what he is staring at.

what_changes.before: Resigned and turning away, beginning to leave the edge of the building.
what_changes.after: Jolted back to attention by something he hears, head snapping around to stare.
what_changes.evidence: He starts to turn from the edge

event_hint.one_line: Agent Smith, about to abandon the rooftop, suddenly detects something and snaps back to focus, continuing the pursuit of Neo, Trinity and Morpheus.
